en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Al Sayyari, raising it, said,
‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> liked the gourd, and he<sup>saww</sup> would order his<sup>saww</sup> wives, when they cooked a pot, so they should be frequenting from the gourd, and it is the pumpkin’.
en.sarwar: 6. Al-Husayn from Muhammad has narrated from al-Sayyariy in a marfu‘ manner who has said the following: “The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause,
liked gourd and would order his wives to increase gourd when they cooked a dish. It is squash.”
